newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia April CPI seen rising 0.55-0.57 pct.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia April CPI seen rising 0.55-0.57 pct.

text.p: Indonesia's consumer price index for April was likely to show a month-on-month rise of 0.55-0.57 percent, compared with a decline of 0.12 percent in March, banking sources said on Tuesday.
The official inflation figure will be announced on Wednesday after the regular monthly cabinet meeting.
Indonesia posted an inflation rate of 6.47 percent for the 1996 calendar year, compared with 8.64 percent in 1995.
The government has forecast an inflation rate of six percent for the 1997/98 fiscal year starting on April 1.
